result:
Confirmed — that's a locally-defined `emit` helper, unrelated to the event bus. Excluding it.

Now compiling the final list of production source files that call the actual event-bus `emit()`:

- src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts
- src/server/jobs/overdue-issue-job.ts
- src/server/jobs/trial-expiry-job.ts
- src/server/services/usage-service.ts
- src/server/services/member-service.ts
- src/server/services/invitation-service.ts
- src/server/services/issue-service.ts
- src/server/services/project-service.ts
- src/server/services/billing-service.ts
- src/server/services/feature-flag-service.ts
- src/server/services/organization-service.ts
- src/server/services/comment-service.ts

`emitAndForget()` (also in event-bus.ts) wraps `emit()` but has no production callers — only its own test exercises it — so it isn't a real publish path, and event-bus.ts itself is the file declaring `emit`, not a caller of it.

ANSWER: src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts, src/server/jobs/overdue-issue-job.ts, src/server/jobs/trial-expiry-job.ts, src/server/services/usage-service.ts, src/server/services/member-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/issue-service.ts, src/server/services/project-service.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/services/feature-flag-service.ts, src/server/services/organization-service.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts
